precision.target: W8A8 dynamic QLinear with FP16 output
precision.target_embedding: INT8 weight times FP32 row scale to FP16
precision.draft_attention_matmul_dtype: float16 by default; float32 reference via factory config
precision.draft_attention_matmul_result: cast to float32; direct FP32 accumulation/output and Cube execution require ATC/device verification

input_identity.repository_source: verify every SOURCE_LOCK.json file/hash pair before checkpoint load
input_identity.external_artifacts: hash-complete quant input manifest is required and reverified before checkpoint load

graph.name: quant_dflash_recompute
graph.shape_policy: static S divisible by 64 and at most 32767; right-padded valid prefix

gdr_effective_length.source: count nonzero attention_mask rows along S inside the graph
gdr_effective_length.semantics: call-local logical valid rows; not physical S, cumulative KV length, or MTP accepted_tokens

custom_operator_export.frontend_schema: npu::adn_rms_norm(Tensor input, Tensor gamma, float epsilon=1e-6) -> (Tensor, Tensor)
custom_operator_export.lowering: one registered GE operator; no Tensor decomposition
custom_operator_export.preservation_gate: converter call count must be positive and dynamo.pbtxt GE-node count must cover every converter call

required_operators.pse_shift: absent; reserved for optional FP16 bias
required_operators.all_seq_lengths_q: SymInt[] frontend -> INT64 GE length input; static cache capacity for incremental graphs
required_operators.logical_prefix: runtime causal mask and key_position < start_position + valid_rows

compiler.runtime_input_abi_gate: incremental graphs normalize GE Data.index and physical Data order by public tensor storage identity before serialization; specialize_float=True; verify static shapes; require one PASS audit per graph before ATC
compiler.custom_op_gate: validate all declared custom-op contracts and SoftplusV2 audits for the entire graph suite before ATC; preserve builtin converters and audit their GE nodes
compiler.soc_policy: exact 310P variant required; generic Ascend310P rejected
compiler.incremental_precision_mode: must_keep_origin_dtype or precision_mode_v2=origin; downcasting modes rejected

runtime.memory: persistent pinned host and device buffers
runtime.synchronization: one stream synchronization per OM invocation
runtime.om_io_validation: exact per-index dtype, bytes, rank and shape before execution; errors include graph/path, expected and actual tensor descriptors, and full failing-model I/O dump

claim_boundary: Host and fake-ACL tests do not prove AIR export, OM conversion, physical 310P correctness, or latency. Those gates require the real locked target environment.

incremental_graphs.commit: acceptance and accepted+1 second GDR are internal to target_verify
incremental_graphs.state: explicit FP16 persistent GDN/conv/KV; FP32 GDR accumulator; current/next device banks and logical cursor
incremental_graphs.verify_discard_outputs: 24 raw FP32 GDR first-pass states in independent device-only buffers; 50331648 bytes; never committed or transferred to host

target_custom_operators.pse_shift: absent; reserved for optional FP16 bias
target_custom_operators.all_seq_lengths_q: SymInt[] frontend -> INT64 GE length input; static cache capacity for incremental graphs
target_custom_operators.logical_prefix: runtime causal mask and key_position < start_position + valid_rows

incremental_graphs.draft_length_policy: runtime proposal_count=K, every attention layer masks block keys after anchor+K, unused output tail zero

profiling.all: one fresh-state window per declared stage, same loaded application PID
profiling.om_entry_default: dflash/all; fresh mode-specific plan from the selected deployment manifest
profiling.operator_grouping: per stage and original CSV; device/model, op/task type, OP State, input/output dtype; do not sum exports or independent/combined windows as request latency
profiling.verify_scope: Python verify contains first-pass GDR, accept-commit contains second-pass GDR; C++ verify contains both passes and in-graph acceptance/committed state
